verdict.rationale: Mercury publishes one official SDK, mercury-go, generated with Stainless, which gives Go developers typed access to the REST API. The same evidence states there is no official npm or PyPI SDK, only community packages, so most mainstream AI-native languages lack first-party SDK coverage. Missing for 10: official TypeScript/JavaScript and Python SDKs, SDK documentation depth beyond the README, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Mercury Go library provides convenient access to the Mercury REST API from applications written in Go... It is generated with Stainless
